# zujwt

The goal of zujwt is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zujwt from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zujwt")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zujwt)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`jose_limits()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zujwt/reference/jose_limits.md)
  : Resource limits for untrusted tokens
- [`jose_peek()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zujwt/reference/jose_peek.md)
  : Look inside a token without verifying it
- [`zujwt_error`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zujwt/reference/zujwt_error.md)
  : Conditions raised by zujwt
